theory_mapping.mapping: Ordered entity features condition antisymmetric graph phases. A degree-normalized Hermitian Hamiltonian generates a unitary; squared coherent multistep amplitudes are transposed into query/key orientation. The centered clipped log prior is added before attention softmax. Identical-H dephasing repeatedly propagates one-step probabilities; the matched classical branch repeatedly propagates a real transition.
theory_mapping.claim_limit: A time-independent Hamiltonian repeated for several steps is longer coherent evolution, not an independently parameterized circuit at each step; no hardware speedup or novel expressivity claim is established.
